category: affiliate site selling Turbobit premium (brand impersonation risk)

free_tier.stated: None sold. The page describes Turbobit's free tier and then sells the premium account.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the page read

retention.stated: Files are deleted after 30 days of inactivity; the period can be extended only by buying premium access or downloading the file.
retention.notes: 30 days of inactivity; the period is extended by a premium account or a download

egress.terms: not stated on the page read; only the premium account is described

interface_detail: Marketing pages in Russian and English plus a Turbobit-clone app shell (/ru/turbobit-help.php, /tos.php, /ru/privacy.php).
tooling: Browser. The site links out to rapidgator-premium.net and ddownload-premium.com for its comparison, i.e. its business is premium-account affiliate sales.
chaining: Nothing to chain: it resells a Turbobit account at an unstated price and its own identity is unclear.

limits.value: no price and no payment method is shown before the checkout; the page sells by description only

limits_note: The page asserts 'Turbobit хостинг управляется компанией Công ty TNHH из Вьетнама' (Turbobit is operated by a Vietnamese LLC), which no Turbobit-operated page read among debrid providers states.
binding_note: No constraint could be measured because the record is about who is being paid, not about a quota. The identity question is settled below and is decisive.

identity_cost.detail: The site sells premium access and links to two other premium shops; the actual payee is not identified on any page read, and its claim that Turbobit is run by a Vietnamese company is unsupported by Turbobit's own pages.

reliability_note: The site presents itself with Turbobit's name and logo and asserts an owner that the vendor's own site does not state; a payment here is not a payment to Turbobit.
confidence_note: The ownership sentence, the affiliate links and the cloned help/TOS pages are all quoted from the live site today. What remains unknown is the payee - which is exactly why the verdict is not 'qualifies'.

evidence.proved: 'Turbobit хостинг управляется компанией Công ty TNHH из Вьетнама' and the outbound links to rapidgator-premium.net and ddownload-premium.com
'Turbobit.net, a website for file hosting and online storage, is a registered company.' - no jurisdiction, no entity name

evidence.proved: the inactivity deletion period is 30 days
evidence.quote: На Turbobit вы всегда видите, сколько времени ваши файлы останутся доступными, прежде чем они будут удалены после 30 дней бездействия.

evidence.proved: the extension methods are a premium account or a download
evidence.quote: Это время можно продлить только с помощью приобретения премиум-аккаунта или скачивания файла.

evidence.proved: the first-party page states a 30-day inactivity deletion period
evidence.quote: На Turbobit вы всегда видите, сколько времени ваши файлы останутся доступными, прежде чем они будут удалены после 30 дней бездействия.

notes: Included because it ranks for Russian 'turbobit premium' queries and looks like the vendor. Candidate explanations considered: (1) it is Turbobit's own Vietnamese-facing brand - contradicted by turbobit.net's own pages, which never name a Vietnamese entity and serve an unrelated app shell; (2) it is an affiliate that bought an expired/typo domain - supported by the clone help pages and the outbound premium-shop links; (3) it is the vendor's own affiliate programme - no evidence. The record states (2) as the plausible reading and refuses to vouch for the payee.
